10 weeks = 70 days.  
Add 7 days → total 77 days.  
1568 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but treat as Gregorian here).  
From 1568-05-14, add 77 days:  
May has 31 days → from May 14: 17 days left in May → 17 days used.  
Remaining 77 - 17 = 60 days.  
June 30 days → 30 days used, remaining 30 days.  
July 31 days → goes into July, 30 days used → date = July 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1568-07-30
